comment: Voice designs for the Qwen3-TTS catalogue. Each description is an archetype: no real person, performer or recording is named or imitated. Designed with Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign; one take per voice is chosen by ear (picks.json) and becomes its reference clip.
referenceText: Good evening. The night is cold, the road is long, and the old house waits at the end of it.

voices.name: The Announcer
voices.description: A deep, warm, booming male radio announcer in his forties, measured and theatrical, crisp diction, studio microphone, mid-twentieth-century broadcast style.

voices.name: The Narrator
voices.description: A calm, clear female storyteller in her thirties with a low, even, slightly husky tone, unhurried pacing, intimate and close to the microphone.

voices.name: Young solicitor
voices.description: A young English solicitor in his late twenties, educated and polite, slightly nervous, clear tenor voice, earnest.

voices.name: Young gentleman
voices.description: A confident, warm young English gentleman of good family in his twenties, open-hearted and impulsive, rich baritone, upper-class accent.

voices.name: Young American
voices.description: An easygoing young man from the American South in his late twenties, relaxed drawl, dry humour, steady and brave.

voices.name: Young workman
voices.description: A cheerful young London labourer in his twenties, quick and chatty, broad working-class accent, a little cheeky.

voices.name: Asylum doctor
voices.description: A precise, thoughtful English physician in his thirties, quietly earnest, measured scientific diction, a hint of melancholy.

voices.name: Feverish inmate
voices.description: An excitable, feverish man in his fifties, voice veering between wheedling softness and sudden intensity, quick breathless phrasing.

voices.name: Police inspector
voices.description: A gruff, steady London police inspector in his forties, practical and unflappable, low gravelly voice.

voices.name: Clergyman
voices.description: A gentle, sonorous English clergyman in his fifties, kindly and slow, resonant voice used to filling a church.

voices.name: Sea captain
voices.description: A stern, weathered Scottish sea captain in his forties, clipped commands, voice roughened by wind and salt.

voices.name: Mountain coachman
voices.description: A rough, taciturn Central European coachman in his forties, deep gravelly voice, heavy accent, few words.

voices.name: Innkeeper
voices.description: A hearty, booming German innkeeper in his fifties, jovial and loud, thick accent, laughs easily.

voices.name: Old nobleman
voices.description: An elderly European nobleman with a slow, courteous, cultured baritone, faintly accented English, quiet menace beneath perfect politeness.

voices.name: Old professor
voices.description: An elderly Dutch scholar in his sixties, warm, emphatic and eccentric, idiosyncratic English with a strong Dutch accent, sudden bursts of energy.

voices.name: Old sailor
voices.description: A very old Yorkshire fisherman near ninety, creaky and wheezy, broad northern dialect, garrulous and grumbling.

voices.name: Old servant
voices.description: A frail, devoted elderly English manservant in his seventies, soft quavering voice, deferential and worried.

voices.name: Old judge
voices.description: A dry, authoritative English magistrate in his sixties, slow and deliberate, crisp consonants, faintly impatient.

voices.name: Teenage boy
voices.description: An eager English boy of sixteen, voice still breaking, quick and excitable, working-class accent.

voices.name: Young boy
voices.description: A bright, curious English boy of about eight, high clear voice, innocent and quick.

voices.name: Young wife
voices.description: An intelligent, warm young Englishwoman in her twenties, steady and resolute, clear mezzo voice, gentle but strong.

voices.name: Society girl
voices.description: A bright, playful young English society woman of nineteen, light and teasing, sweet high voice, quick laughter.

voices.name: Housemaid
voices.description: A quick, cheerful young Irish housemaid in her twenties, lilting accent, brisk and warm.

voices.name: Pale lady
voices.description: A silky, languid young woman with a low, honeyed voice, slow and teasing, faintly foreign, with something cold and hungry beneath the sweetness.

voices.name: Village landlady
voices.description: An anxious Central European innkeeper's wife in her fifties, pleading and fearful, strong accent, voice trembling with urgency.

voices.name: Governess
voices.description: A crisp, proper English governess in her forties, precise diction, cool and composed, faintly stern.

voices.name: Nurse
voices.description: A kind, practical English nurse in her thirties, calm and reassuring, warm mid-range voice.

voices.name: Invalid mother
voices.description: A frail, gentle English widow in her sixties, an invalid, soft breathy voice, affectionate and easily tired.

voices.name: Elderly nun
voices.description: A serene elderly nun in her seventies, soft-spoken and kindly, slow careful English with a faint Central European accent.

voices.name: Old woman
voices.description: A very old village woman, cracked and reedy voice, ominous and muttering, heavy rural accent.

voices.name: Teenage girl
voices.description: A shy, sweet English girl of fifteen, soft clear voice, hesitant and polite.

voices.name: Young girl
voices.description: A small English girl of about seven, high bright voice, earnest and a little breathless.

voices.name: Calm stranger
voices.description: An androgynous adult voice of indeterminate gender, calm and even, mid-range pitch, neutral English accent, unreadable.

voices.name: Ageless whisperer
voices.description: An ageless, androgynous voice, dry and papery, quiet and uncanny, slow deliberate speech with an air of secrets.
